name: zclass_cls_di_build_pick_candidates_for_points
description: zClass_cls_di::BuildPickCandidatesForPoints gates point-batch pick traversal by node flags and variant tag, dispatches object/animate/light/sequence classes, applies per-node transforms, and accumulates probe candidates per sample bucket.
